verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Stripe's docs reference official npm packages/SDKs for integration (stripe-tax-probe-1) and Stripe Tax is built on the standard Stripe API with docs pages (stripe-tax-docs-1..14), implying SDK-based access, but the pack contains no explicit list of official language SDKs, code samples in multiple languages, or SDK-specific documentation for Tax endpoints. missing for 10: explicit official SDK list/pages for Stripe Tax, multi-language code samples, versioning/release notes for SDKs.
